purpose: Zero-base PIT feature and universe screen for same-session open-to-close top-two ranking.

decision.display_policy: rank one and rank two every scheduled source-complete session
decision.screen_rule: A group advances only if discovery net20 uplift is positive, top-five-days-removed uplift is nonnegative, at least half of discovery months have positive uplift, and the shared max-t block-bootstrap 80% lower bound is nonnegative. Confirmation is reported without reselection.

H01_cross_sectional_state.mechanism: Replace unstable raw units with target-day cross-sectional percentiles computed only from prior-price features.
features: xsec ranks of raw G0 state and horizon spreads

H02_expanding_stock_alpha.mechanism: Estimate persistent stock-specific intraday drift with expanding prior outcomes and empirical-Bayes shrinkage toward zero.

H03_downside_asymmetry.mechanism: Distinguish equal-volatility stocks by prior downside semideviation and large-loss versus large-gain frequencies.

H04_horizon_transition.mechanism: Represent acceleration or decay across 1, 5, 20 and 60-session intraday and overnight horizons.

H05_market_regime_switch.mechanism: Allow stock reversal, momentum and historical alpha to change sign with prior-session market breadth, tails, dispersion and volatility.

H06_calendar_stock_interaction.mechanism: Capture recurring weekday and month-end stock behavior using known-before-open calendar interactions and prior same-weekday outcomes.

H07_tradability_quality.mechanism: Use lagged no-trade, flat-session and zero-range propensity as a continuous reliability modifier rather than a tuned hard cutoff.

H08_lot_price_state.mechanism: Use strictly prior share price as a minimum-lot affordability and microstructure proxy, without interpreting it as market capitalisation.

H09_range_exhaustion.mechanism: Separate continuation from exhaustion by combining the last close-to-close shock, prior close location and lagged range expansion.

H10_gap_response_state.mechanism: Condition the most recent historical gap on each stock's prior gap-fill and response traits.

H11_cross_sectional_crowding.mechanism: Measure whether momentum and volatility signals are crowded across the daily candidate universe and interact crowding with stock state.
features: daily momentum dispersion/tails by stock momentum
daily ATR dispersion/tails by stock alpha

H12_history_source_quality.mechanism: Expose short history, missing technical state and stale prior-price source as model uncertainty rather than silently relying on imputation.

universe_hypotheses.U03_affordable_lot: Require strictly prior close between 200 and 5000 yen (one standard lot approximately 20,000 to 500,000 yen).
universe_hypotheses.U04_mature_history: Require at least 180 prior sessions with an observed open-to-close return.
universe_hypotheses.U05_tail_clean: Require prior rolling 60-session frequency of open-to-close losses <= -2 percent to be <= 0.05.
